Bug_Title: Optional value should only be accessed after calling isPresent()
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by directly accessing the value of an Optional using the get() method without first checking if the value is present using isPresent() or isEmpty(). This will result in a NoSuchElementException if the Optional is empty.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the methods `showBug` and `showBug2` of the `OptionalBugExample` class. These methods directly access the value of an Optional using the get() method without first checking if the value is present using isPresent() or isEmpty(), which results in a NoSuchElementException if the Optional is empty.
